releases.name: opencode-forgekeeper: v3.3.0
releases.body:
## 🎉 Forgekeeper comes to OpenCode Desktop and the web

Follow your PRs and MRs beyond the terminal. Forgekeeper 3.3.0 brings a composer status pill, resizable status and review-feedback panels, and notifications to OpenCode Desktop.

In the web app, use `/forge-report` and `/forge-inbox` to check status and review updates directly in the conversation.

Desktop’s review inbox also lets you summarize feedback, start work, acknowledge updates, and pause monitoring without leaving the app.

### Desktop status and review updates

![OpenCode Desktop showing a merged MR, review-update summaries, and the Forgekeeper status panel.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pedropombeiro/opencode-plugins/636694f463b4a2e1511f39b29f6c68f3dffc1f27/packages/forgekeeper/images/desktop-status.png)

### Spot merge conflicts

Conflicts appear in both the composer pill and the status panel.

![OpenCode Desktop showing a PR with merge conflicts in the composer pill and Forgekeeper status panel.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pedropombeiro/opencode-plugins/636694f463b4a2e1511f39b29f6c68f3dffc1f27/packages/forgekeeper/images/desktop-conflicts.png)
